P7 east bedroom front furnished in parts/room-44.mjs: orange bed (foot 92,8,10, head 93,8,10 on the east wall), two barrel dresser with a flower pot on the east wall, a rug and a fence-and-top-slab table with a standing lantern (92,10,12) that lights the room.
The x91 lane (door, stair landing, stair headroom) is kept clear. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines for this part.
The bed is refused in the current build because shell B's east wall x94 is still a stub here; in a scratch grid with that wall the bed places correctly.
left: The bed (92..93,8,10) is refused in the merged-stub build until shell B builds the east wall at x94 z10; bed_set returns false silently and make.sh reports 7 placed, not 9. Re-check after the merge.
The room check prints NEEDS WORK only because the building around the room is still stubs (0 of 5 cells reachable from the entrance); re-run `$MCD room` after all parts are merged.
Light is min 11 on the floor cells (the lantern at 92,10,12 on the table), so no dark cell, but this was measured without the walls and the bed.

No checkbox for this room exists in plan.md; the elements.md item 'Stairs x88 and x91 z15->11; 3 beds per unit' is the whole duplex's and is only partly met here (one bed of this unit's bedroom). Left unticked.
The LOOK render (room.png) shows the furniture only: no walls, no bed yet, so it can't judge the room's read until the shell is in.

waste.what: Worked out the room's cell roles (stair headroom at x91 z11..14, lane, bed and wall cells) by hand from the plan's floor grid, which marks the x94 wall cells as D although plan.md says solid at z10 and a window at z11.
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate checks and 3 peeks at build.nbt cells, one of which returned undefined for air
waste.tool: A `mcd plan` legend that separates a real doorway from a window and from an unbuilt wall, plus `mcd cell build.nbt x,y,z` to read a cell.

waste.what: Discovered by reading the make output that bed_set refused: the line says '7 placed' with no reason. Had to test the bed in a scratch Grid with a temporary wall to confirm the helper works.
waste.tool: Helpers (bed_set, flight, chimney) should return and log a refusal reason, and the runParts part report should show refused helper calls, not just placed counts.

waste.what: Room verification runs against the whole building, so the walk verdict is NO WAY IN while the shell is still stubs. Testing one room alone meant a hand-built scratch Grid.
waste.cost: one scratch Grid script, about 2 minutes
waste.tool: `mcd room --isolate` (or a rooms.json option) that walls the room's box and gives it a synthetic entrance, so a room can be checked before its neighbours are merged.
